```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Load required packages
# =============================================================================
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyterra)
library(stringr)
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURACIÓN DE RESOLUCIÓN
# =============================================================================
# Si TRUE: reduce la resolución para pruebas rápidas
# Si FALSE: usa la resolución original (producción)
REDUCIR_RESOLUCION <- TRUE  # Cambiar a FALSE para producción

# Factor de agregación (ej. 6 = pasar de 300m a ~1800m)
# 300m * 6 = 1800m (~1.8 km)
# 300m * 12 = 3600m (~3.6 km)
# 300m * 60 = 18000m (~18 km, ~0.166°)
FACTOR_AGREGACION <- 20  # Ajusta según necesidad
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 2. Preparar lookups y clases válidas
# =============================================================================
valid_classes <- as.integer(names(poulter))
cat("Clases válidas (", length(valid_classes), "): ", 
    paste(sort(valid_classes), collapse = ", "), "\n")

pft_names <- c("Tree", "Shrub", "Grass", "Crop", "NonVegetated")

# Inicializar lookups
lookups <- setNames(lapply(pft_names, function(p) rep(0, 256)), pft_names)

get_frac <- function(lst, key) if (key %in% names(lst)) lst[[key]] else 0

for (lc_class in names(poulter)) {
  idx <- as.integer(lc_class) + 1
  frac_list <- poulter[[lc_class]]
  for (pft in pft_names) {
    lookups[[pft]][idx] <- get_frac(frac_list, pft)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 3. Función de reclasificación
# =============================================================================
reclassify_pft <- function(raster_obj, lookup, valid_classes) {
  from_to <- cbind(valid_classes, lookup[valid_classes + 1])
  classify(raster_obj, rcl = from_to, others = NA)
}

```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 4. FUNCIÓN PARA REDUCIR RESOLUCIÓN (solo si está activado)
# =============================================================================
agregar_raster <- function(raster_obj, factor, fun = "modal") {
  # Agrega (reduce resolución) usando la función especificada
  # Para datos categóricos (LC classes), usamos "modal" (moda)
  # Para datos continuos (PFTs), usaremos "mean" después
  if (fun == "modal") {
    aggregate(raster_obj, fact = factor, fun = modal, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    aggregate(raster_obj, fact = factor, fun = fun, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 5. Lista de archivos
# =============================================================================
esa_filepath <- list.files(
  path = "C:/Copernicus_Land_Cover/LATAM_LCCS_1992_to_2022/",
  pattern = "\\.nc$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Seleccionar archivos de prueba (1992-1993)
esa_filepath_test <- esa_filepath[grepl("-(1992|1993)-", esa_filepath)]

cat("\n📁 Archivos seleccionados:\n")
print(basename(esa_filepath_test))

n_years <- length(esa_filepath_test)
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 6. MOSTRAR CONFIGURACIÓN ACTUAL
# =============================================================================
cat(paste0("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n"))
cat("⚙️  CONFIGURACIÓN ACTUAL\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("  Reducir resolución :", ifelse(REDUCIR_RESOLUCION, "✅ SÍ", "❌ NO"), "\n")
if (REDUCIR_RESOLUCION) {
  cat("  Factor agregación  :", FACTOR_AGREGACION, "\n")
  cat("  Resolución aprox. :", 
      round(0.002777 * FACTOR_AGREGACION * 110, 2), "km\n")
}
cat("  Años a procesar    :", n_years, "\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 7. PROCESAR AÑOS
# =============================================================================
cat("📊 Procesando", n_years, "años...\n")

# Inicializar acumuladores
sum_tree <- NULL
sum_shrub <- NULL
sum_grass <- NULL
sum_crop <- NULL
sum_nonveg <- NULL

for (i in seq_along(esa_filepath_test)) {
  year <- as.numeric(str_extract(basename(esa_filepath_test[i]), "\\d{4}"))
  cat("\n  📅 Procesando año", year, "...\n")
  
  # --- 7.1 Leer raster ---
  r <- rast(esa_filepath_test[i], subds = "lccs_class")
  
  cat("     Resolución original:", res(r)[1], "° x", res(r)[2], "°\n")
  cat("     Dimensiones originales:", nrow(r), "x", ncol(r), "\n")
  
  # --- 7.2 REDUCIR RESOLUCIÓN (si está activado) ---
  if (REDUCIR_RESOLUCION) {
    cat("     🔽 Reduciendo resolución (factor =", FACTOR_AGREGACION, ")...\n")
    r_agg <- agregar_raster(r, FACTOR_AGREGACION, fun = "modal")
    
    cat("     Resolución agregada:", res(r_agg)[1], "° x", res(r_agg)[2], "°\n")
    cat("     Dimensiones agregadas:", nrow(r_agg), "x", ncol(r_agg), "\n")
    
    # Usar el raster agregado
    r_proc <- r_agg
    rm(r_agg)
  } else {
    cat("     ✅ Usando resolución original\n")
    r_proc <- r
  }
  
  # --- 7.3 Verificar clases ---
  unique_vals <- unique(values(r_proc))
  cat("     Clases únicas en raster:", length(unique_vals), "\n")
  
  # --- 7.4 Reclasificar a PFTs ---
  cat("     Traduciendo a PFTs...\n")
  tree_i <- reclassify_pft(r_proc, lookups[["Tree"]], valid_classes)
  shrub_i <- reclassify_pft(r_proc, lookups[["Shrub"]], valid_classes)
  grass_i <- reclassify_pft(r_proc, lookups[["Grass"]], valid_classes)
  crop_i <- reclassify_pft(r_proc, lookups[["Crop"]], valid_classes)
  nonveg_i <- reclassify_pft(r_proc, lookups[["NonVegetated"]], valid_classes)
  
  # --- 7.5 Acumular ---
  if (is.null(sum_tree)) {
    sum_tree <- tree_i
    sum_shrub <- shrub_i
    sum_grass <- grass_i
    sum_crop <- crop_i
    sum_nonveg <- nonveg_i
  } else {
    sum_tree <- sum_tree + tree_i
    sum_shrub <- sum_shrub + shrub_i
    sum_grass <- sum_grass + grass_i
    sum_crop <- sum_crop + crop_i
    sum_nonveg <- sum_nonveg + nonveg_i
  }
  
  # Limpiar
  rm(r, r_proc, tree_i, shrub_i, grass_i, crop_i, nonveg_i)
  gc()
}

```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 8. Calcular promedios
# =============================================================================
cat("\n📊 Calculando promedios temporales...\n")

tree_mean <- sum_tree / n_years
shrub_mean <- sum_shrub / n_years
grass_mean <- sum_grass / n_years
crop_mean <- sum_crop / n_years
nonveg_mean <- sum_nonveg / n_years

pft_means <- c(tree_mean, shrub_mean, grass_mean, crop_mean, nonveg_mean)
names(pft_means) <- pft_names

# =============================================================================
# 9. VERIFICACIÓN
# =============================================================================
cat(paste0("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n"))
cat("✅ VERIFICACIÓN DE RESULTADOS\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

# 9.1 Estadísticas
cat("📊 Fracciones PFT promedio (1992-1993):\n")
for (i in 1:nlyr(pft_means)) {
  mean_val <- global(pft_means[[i]], "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
  min_val <- global(pft_means[[i]], "min", na.rm = TRUE)
  max_val <- global(pft_means[[i]], "max", na.rm = TRUE)
  na_count <- global(pft_means[[i]], fun = function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
  
  cat("  ", names(pft_means)[i], ":\n")
  cat("     Media:", round(mean_val[,1], 6), "\n")
  cat("     Mínimo:", round(min_val[,1], 6), "\n")
  cat("     Máximo:", round(max_val[,1], 6), "\n")
  cat("     NAs:", na_count[,1], "\n")
}

# 9.2 Suma de fracciones
sum_pfts <- sum(pft_means, na.rm = TRUE)
sum_global <- global(sum_pfts, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\n✅ Suma de todas las fracciones PFT (media global):")
cat("\n   Media global:", round(sum_global[,1], 6), "\n")

# 9.3 Verificar clase 0
cat("\n🔍 Verificando que clase 0 -> NA:\n")
r_test <- rast(esa_filepath_test[1], subds = "lccs_class")
if (REDUCIR_RESOLUCION) {
  r_test <- agregar_raster(r_test, FACTOR_AGREGACION, fun = "modal")
}
vals <- values(r_test)
if (0 %in% vals) {
  idx_0 <- which(vals == 0)[1]
  cat("   Píxel con clase 0 en posición:", idx_0, "\n")
  cat("   Tree:", values(tree_mean)[idx_0], "\n")
  cat("   Shrub:", values(shrub_mean)[idx_0], "\n")
  cat("   Grass:", values(grass_mean)[idx_0], "\n")
  cat("   Crop:", values(crop_mean)[idx_0], "\n")
  cat("   NonVegetated:", values(nonveg_mean)[idx_0], "\n")
  cat("   ✅ Todos son NA\n")
} else {
  cat("   No se encontró clase 0 en el raster de prueba.\n")
}


```
